subject: Class 717 in Great Northern livery
method: Body as the 700's (the same Desiro City body; the 717's Commons diagram is 130 px tall, 3 cm a pixel, and its car is inconsistent with its own windows, so it is not used for lengths); the front measured on 717023 (Finsbury Park, near head-on) by a symmetric projective fit across and the 700's measured heights, then checked by camera.

Artwork 290 x 152 for box and pennant: 0.875 m tall, centred 10.53 m, 1.39 m. Car 2 not seen
trace.face.number: 717023 (p023): the number sits on the black of the front door, its top level with the side screens' foot (2.12 m) and clear of the mask's lower edge (1.97 m): centred 2.10 m (it was 2.02 m, which ran its foot 3 cm off the black onto the white, as the render showed)
trace.face.outlines: 717023 (p023) head-on, scaled by its picked tail lamps (1072 px for 2.42 m: 443 px/m) from their centre (1.74 m): one black mask across the whole upper face, +-1.31 m, from the orange line (3.48-3.51 m) straight down to 1.93 m, holding both screens and the front door's upper half; the door's lower half white with its outline down to 1.03 m; the lamp pods' tops meet the mask (1.93 m); white cheeks below and the coupler's recess between them, +-0.66 m, up to 1.03 m (it was +-0.75 m to 1.14 m, a broad black block). Before: {"mask": {"half": 1.31, "lo": 1.97, "hi": 3.4, "r": 0.22}, "pods": {"inner": 0.89, "outer": 1.38, "lo": 1.47, "hi": 1.86, "r": 0.1}, "lower": {"half": 0.75, "lo": 0.5, "hi": 1.14}, "door": {"half": 0.53, "lo": 1.97, "hi": 3.38, "window": [2.55, 3.25]}}; the front door's window doesn't show: on 717023 its upper half is one black with the mask (the window dark behind it), so it is no longer drawn as a lighter pane; as on the 700, the black reaches up to just under the orange line (3.54 m) nearly the cab's full width (drawn 1.36 m), was 3.48 m and 1.31 m
trace.face.pods: 717023 (p023, the right pod at 443 px/m from the tail lamps, centre 1141 px, up from the tails at 1.74 m; the view is a little off-axis so the outer end reads wide): the same slanted quadrilateral as the 700/707, its inner edge from 0.98 m at 1.86 m to 0.84 m at 1.44 m, the outer end rounded at 1.33-1.375 m; the red tail a large LED cluster (r 0.09) outboard, the small white headlamp below and inboard; first render (a crop): the lamps read as small dots in a black box: the pod is dark smoked glass over a red LED cluster and a chrome headlamp nearly filling it, so the lamps are drawn glazed (Face.lampStyle) at their measured size; third pass (a closeup): the lenses are big round units nearly the pod's full height, side by side: tail r 0.1, head r 0.06; the unlit tail a red lens over its LEDs (Face.glazedTail)
